Subject: Demo recap + proposed POC plan — FinTechCorp

Hi Oliver / Priya,

Thanks again for taking time today — really appreciated the thoughtful questions from the product and infra teams. Recap from the demo + a proposed POC/evaluation plan below so we can align on success criteria and ownership. I attached a one-page POC evaluation plan and a draft SOW for scope/estimates.

Quick recap of what we showed:
- Redwood hosted API + Dedicated option for predictable throughput
- Model catalog and rollout controls (canary / A/B)
- Observability: per-route latency/cost, token-level breakdowns, and evals

Proposed POC objective:
- Validate integration with FinTechCorp transaction enrichment pipeline and measure inference latency & cost at 99th percentile under realistic traffic.

Success criteria (suggested):
1) Avg latency (p50/p95/p99) for end-to-end enrichment under test load: p95 <= 250ms, p99 <= 500ms.
2) Token cost per enriched event within target budget (we'll baseline after initial run).
3) Model output quality: precision on classification tasks >= 90% on your labeled testset (we can run evaluation harness).
4) No sensitive customer data leaves your VPC during private deployment (if you opt for Private).

Proposed timeline (2-week technical POC + 2-week evaluation):
- Week 1 (Mar 8–12): Sandbox integration + sample data ingest (Redwood dev assist).
- Week 2 (Mar 15–19): Load tests, tuning (batching/quantization), initial quality eval.
- Week 3 (Mar 22–26): Expanded evaluation with additional datasets; stakeholder review.
- Week 4 (Mar 29–Apr 2): Final findings, recommendations, and next steps (Dedicated sizing or Hosted plan).

Owners / resources
- FinTechCorp: Oliver (tech lead) — integration + test data; Priya (PM) — success criteria sign-off.
- Redwood: Marissa (AE) — program lead; Dev Patel (Solutions Eng) — technical lead; Laura Bennett (CS) — POC success manager.

Next steps (please confirm):
1) Confirm success criteria above or share edits
2) Confirm target POC start date (we tentatively propose Mar 8)
3) Share sample dataset or a sanitized extract for baseline quality checks

Attachments: [POC-eval-plan.pdf (application/pdf, 28 KB)], [SOW-draft.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document, 52 KB)]

Happy to hop on a 30-min planning call if helpful — I put a few suggested slots in the HubSpot event (link below).

Oliver / team — happy to jump on this. Quick answers:

1) Data residency: Redwood supports region-based routing. For Hosted we can route inference to US or EU regions depending on your account config; for strict residency we recommend Redwood Private (VPC) — during the POC we can run in your preferred cloud region. I can share the infra diagram and data flow docs if that helps.

2) Engineering effort: For the sandbox integration (Week 1) plan 1–2 full days of SE/your eng time for ingest wiring and auth (assuming you use our Java or Python SDKs). We have Java examples for Kafka and HTTP-based ingestion; I'll drop sample snippets in a follow-up message.

3) Load testing approach: proposed is step-and-hold for 10 minutes per step up to target QPS, measure p50/p95/p99 and tail for the enrichment path. We'll provide a small test harness and can run it together in a shared environment.

I can be available next Tue (Mar 9) 10–11am PT for a short technical sync.
